facts.claim: Oosterdam (Holland America Line): Entered service 2003; 82,305 GT; 1990 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 285 m length; Vista class.
MS Oosterdam is a Vista class cruise ship of the Holland America Line, a division of Carnival Corporation & plc.
Launched in 2002 as the line's second Vista, Oosterdam is sister to MS Noordam, MS Westerdam, and MS Zuiderdam.
